no_claim: Nothing here is a measurement. No construct in the pool has been made.
No claim that this project's method is better than mRNAutilus in general. It ranks in-solution half-life better on one held-out set where mRNAutilus is out-of-domain.
No claim that mRNAutilus's half-life head is poor at in-cell decay, which is what it was trained for and was not tested here.
No claim that mRNAutilus resolves this design pool; spread on an arbitrary scale is not resolution against measurement error.
No claim that this project's objective is free of the GC collapse. It is not. The comparison shows the collapse is escapable, not escaped.
mRNAutilus code and weights are not redistributed here; only URLs and hashes are pinned.
purpose: Compare mRNAutilus against this project's objective on sequences this project had already scored, before changing any of this project's code.

run_a_same_pool_both_methods.but_their_translation_head_is_substantia: Their translation_rate head correlates with transcript GC at r = +0.6811 and their ribo_seq head at r = +0.3017. Being a learned model does not by itself escape composition confounding; it escaped on the stability head and did not on the translation head.
run_a_same_pool_both_methods.finding_their_half_life_head_is_not_a_gc: This project's objective correlates with transcript GC at r = +0.99 on this pool. mRNAutilus's half-life head correlates with GC at r = -0.2636 and with this project's objective at r = -0.2262. Their stability head is therefore reading something other than base composition, and it disagrees with this project's objective in SIGN. That is the single most useful result of this comparison: it shows the GC collapse recorded in gate v12 is a property of this project's calibration, not an unavoidable fact about the design pool.
run_a_same_pool_both_methods.no_resolution_claim: Their scores spread across the pool, but their outputs are on an arbitrary normalised scale and no measurement-derived error model exists for it. This project's resolution floor was derived from replicate measurement error in hours and cannot be transferred. It is therefore NOT established that mRNAutilus resolves members this project's objective leaves unresolved. Spread is not resolution.

run_b_held_out_measured_records.cds_inference: longest ATG..in-frame-stop, no internal stop; 123 of 123
run_b_held_out_measured_records.fairness: This comparison is NOT symmetric and must not be cited as mRNAutilus being worse at its own task. On this test set this project is in-domain and mRNAutilus is out-of-domain. The only sound conclusion is about in-solution stability specifically.
run_b_held_out_measured_records.finding: This project's objective ranks the held-out measured records better overall (Spearman +0.3268 versus +0.1747) and is better in every bin at 1.25x and above. mRNAutilus is slightly better in the narrowest bin (0.5250 versus 0.4936), but both sit at chance there and the pairs are not independent, so that difference is not a result.

their_head_is_non_monotonic.most_likely_explanation: Their head is trained on in-cell decay (Saluki) and these records measure in-solution degradation. The two quantities agree about which RNAs are grossly unstable and need not agree in between. This is the out-of-domain direction declared before the run.
their_head_is_non_monotonic.statement: mRNAutilus's half-life head is strongly concordant on the largest differences (0.8722 above 2x) yet BELOW chance in the 1.25-1.50 and 1.50-2.00 bins. A predictor that inverts on moderate differences while succeeding on large ones is not simply weaker; it is ordering something else.

run_b_held_out_measured_records.which_arm_is_ours: 'ours' is the FROZEN production calibration, the one-component PLS whose predictions this project actually emits (held-out Spearman +0.32677, reproduced here as +0.32677). 'ours_ols_refit_arm' is the ordinary-least-squares refit used inside stability_ablation_v1 so that ablation variants were internally comparable. The two differ slightly: in the narrowest bin the frozen calibration gives 0.4936 and the OLS refit gives 0.5007. Earlier narrative in this project quoted the 0.5007 refit figure for the narrowest bin; the frozen calibration's own figure is 0.4936. Both are at chance and no conclusion depends on which is cited, but they are different arms and are kept labelled separately here.

what_this_changes: The GC collapse is not forced by the design pool. An independent model scores the same 512 transcripts with near-zero GC dependence, so a stability objective over this pool that is not a GC meter is reachable.

Their representation is not uniformly better: it is out-of-domain for in-solution half-life and it inverts on moderate differences there, while its translation head carries the composition confound this project has been tracking.
Neither method has demonstrated resolution in the narrow bin that matters for choosing among candidate designs. Both are at chance below 1.10x.
